hellforged-land-raider-proteus.name: Hellforged Land Raider Proteus
hellforged-land-raider-proteus.transport: This unit can transport up to 10 friendly <LEGION> INFANTRY models. Each TERMINATOR and JUMP PACK model takes the space of 2 other INFANTRY models and each CULT OF DESTRUCTION model takes the space of 3 other INFANTRY models. If this model has an Accursed Phylactery, it can only transport up to 6 models.

hellforged-land-raider-achilles.name: Hellforged Land Raider Achilles
hellforged-land-raider-achilles.transport: This unit can transport up to 6 friendly <LEGION> INFANTRY models. Each TERMINATOR and JUMP PACK model takes the space of 2 other INFANTRY models and each CULT OF DESTRUCTION model takes the space of 3 other INFANTRY models. If this model has an Accursed Phylactery, it can only transport up to 6 models.

hellforged-spartan-assault-tank.name: Hellforged Spartan Assault Tank
hellforged-spartan-assault-tank.transport: This unit can transport up to 25 friendly LEGION INFANTRY models. Each TERMINATOR and JUMP PACK model takes the space of 2 other INFANTRY models and each CULT OF DESTRUCTION model takes the space of 3 other INFANTRY models.

hellforged-dreadclaw-drop-pod.name: Hellforged Dreadclaw Drop Pod
hellforged-dreadclaw-drop-pod.transport: This unit can transport up to 10 friendly <LEGION> INFANTRY models, or 1 friendly CHAOS DECIMATOR model, or 1 friendly HELBRUTE model. Each TERMINATOR and JUMP PACK model takes the space of 2 other INFANTRY models and each CULT OF DESTRUCTION model takes the space of 3 other INFANTRY models.

hellforged-kharybdis-assault-claw.name: Hellforged Kharybdis Assault Claw
hellforged-kharybdis-assault-claw.transport: This unit can transport up to 20 friendly <LEGION> INFANTRY models, or up to 3 friendly <LEGION> HELLFORGED RAPIER units or 1 friendly CHAOS DECIMATOR model, or 1 friendly HELBRUTE model. Each TERMINATOR and JUMP PACK model takes the space of 2 other INFANTRY models and each CULT OF DESTRUCTION model takes the space of 3 other INFANTRY models.

hellforged-mastodon.name: Hellforged Mastodon
hellforged-mastodon.transport:
This unit can transport friendly <LEGION> models in one of the following combinations:
-- Up to 40 INFANTRY models.
-- Up to 30 INFANTRY models and 1 CHAOS DECIMATOR or HELBRUTE model.
-- Up to 20 INFANTRY models and up to 2 CHAOS DECIMATOR or HELBRUTE models.
Each TERMINATOR and JUMP PACK model takes the space of 2 other Infantry models and each CULT OF DESTRUCTION model takes the space of 3 other INFANTRY models.

chaos-storm-eagle-assault-gunship.name: Chaos Storm Eagle Assault Gunship
chaos-storm-eagle-assault-gunship.transport: This unit can transport up to 20 friendly LEGION INFANTRY models. Each TERMINATOR and JUMP PACK model takes the space of 2 other INFANTRY models and each CULT OF DESTRUCTION model takes the space of 3 other INFANTRY models.

chaos-thunderhawk-assault-gunship.name: Chaos Thunderhawk Assault Gunship
chaos-thunderhawk-assault-gunship.transport: This unit can transport up to 30 friendly LEGION INFANTRY, BIKER or CAVALRY models. Each BIKER or CAVALRY model tales the space of 3 INFANTRY models, each TERMINATOR and JUMP PACK model takes the space of 2 other INFANTRY models and each CULT OF DESTRUCTION model takes the space of 3 other INFANTRY models.

chaos-sokar-pattern-stormbird-gunship.name: Chaos Sokar Pattern Stormbird Gunship
chaos-sokar-pattern-stormbird-gunship.transport: This unit can transport up to 50 friendly <LEGION> INFANTRY, BIKER and CAVALRY models, or up to 25 friendly <LEGION> INFANTRY, BIKER and CAVALRY  models and 1 friendly CHAOS RHINO. Each BIKER or CAVALRY model tales the space of 3 INFANTRY models, each TERMINATOR and JUMP PACK model takes the space of 2 other INFANTRY models and each CULT OF DESTRUCTION model takes the space of 3 otherINFANTRY models. A CHAOS RHINO can transport models whilst it is embarked aboard this unit.

terrax-pattern-termite-assault-drill.name: Terrax-Pattern Termite Assault Drill
terrax-pattern-termite-assault-drill.transport: This unit can transport 12 friendly <LEGION> INFANTRY models. It cannot transport JUMP PACK, TERMINATOR or CULT OF DESTRUCTION models.

chaos-rhino.name: Chaos Rhino
chaos-rhino.transport: This unit can transport up to 10 friendly DEATH GUARD INFANTRY models. It cannot transport TERMINATORS or JUMP PACK units.

chaos-land-raider.name: Chaos Land Raider
chaos-land-raider.transport: This unit can transport up to 10 friendly THOUSAND SONS INFANTRY models. Each TERMINATOR and JUMP PACK model takes up the space of two other models.

let-the-galaxy-burn.name: Let The Galaxy Burn
let-the-galaxy-burn.text: Re-roll wound rolls of 1 for attacks made by HERETIC ASTARTES units in this Detachment.

blind-fury.name: Blind Fury
blind-fury.text: This unit cannot Fall Back whilst it is within 1" of any enemy INFANTRY units.

blighted-weapons.name: Blighted Weapons
blighted-weapons.text: Re-roll wound rolls of 1 for attacks made by this unit.

doomsday-reactor.name: Doomsday Reactor
doomsday-reactor.text: When this unit is destroyed, it explodes on a result of 6+.

runes-of-the-blood-god.name: Runes of the Blood God
runes-of-the-blood-god.text: When a Psyker unit successfully hits this unit with a weapon that has the Witchfire ability, roll one D12; on a 10+ place one blast marker next to that Psyker unit.

accursed-phylactery.name: Accursed Phylactery
accursed-phylactery.text: Enemy units cannot be set up within 12" of any enemy units that have an Accursed Phylactery unit during the Set Up Reinforcements step.

helical-targeting-array.name: Helical Targeting Array
helical-targeting-array.text: When this unit makes a Shoot action, if it has remained stationary this turn, add the Anti-air ability to its weapons for that action.

hellfire-veil.name: Hellfire Veil
hellfire-veil.text: Add 1 to saving throws made for <LEGION> units whilst they are within 6" of any friendly <LEGION> units that have a Hellfire Veil.

artillery-battery.name: Artillery Battery
artillery-battery.text: Each Heavy Support slot in a Detachment allows you to take up to three of this unit in your army, instead of one. Each unit taken for a single Heavy Support slot must be placed at the same time and within 6" of each other unit taken for the same slot the first time they are set up.

dreadhammer-siege-cannon-2.name: Dreadhammer Siege Cannon
dreadhammer-siege-cannon-2.text: When this unit makes a Shoot action, if it has remained stationary this turn, double the range of its Dreadhammer Siege Cannon for that action.

helwrought-bombs.name: Helwrought Bombs
helwrought-bombs.text: When this unit finishes making a Move action, select one enemy unit it moved over whilst making that Move action. Roll three D6, subtracting 1 from each result if that unit is a Character; for each result of 4+ place one blast marker next to that unit.

mutated-beyond-reason.name: Mutated Beyond Reason
mutated-beyond-reason.text: When this unit makes a Fight action, before picking targets, roll one D3 on the table below to determine what mutation it gains until the end of that action.

1-razor-claws.name: 1 - Razor Claws
1-razor-claws.text: Add 1 to wound rolls for attacks made by this unit with melee weapons.

2-grasping-pseudopods.name: 2 - Grasping Pseudopods
2-grasping-pseudopods.text: Add 1 to this unit’s Attacks characteristic.

3-toxic-haemorrhage.name: 3 - Toxic Haemorrhage
3-toxic-haemorrhage.text: Re-roll wound rolls of 1 for attacks made by this unit with melee weapons.

writhing-tentacles.name: Writhing Tentacles
writhing-tentacles.text: Each time this unit fights with a melee weapon, roll one D3 for every 5 models this unit contains to determine the number of attacks it makes.

infernal-regeneration.name: Infernal Regeneration
infernal-regeneration.text: At the start of the Action phase, you can remove one damage marker from this unit.

machina-malifica.name: Machina Malifica
machina-malifica.text: Each time a blast marker is placed next to an enemy unit as a result of an attack made by this unit with a melee weapon, if no damage markers have been removed from this unit as a result of this ability this turn roll one D6; on a 4+ you can remove one damage marker from this unit.

bulky.name: Bulky
bulky.text: This unit cannot embark aboard a TRANSPORT.

in-the-belly-of-the-beast.name: In the Belly of the Beast
in-the-belly-of-the-beast.text: When a unit disembarks from this unit, roll one D6. On a 1 place one blast marker next to that unit and roll one D6; on a 4+ you can remove one damage marker from this unit.

hover-jet.name: Hover Jet
hover-jet.text: At the start of the Action phase, you can declare that this unit will hover. If it does, then until the end of the phase, its Move characteristic changes to 20" but it loses the Supersonic ability.

void-shields.name: Void Shields
void-shields.text: At the start of the Damage phase, you can remove one blast marker from this unit. Small blast markers must be removed before large blast markers.

projected-void-fields.name: Projected Void Fields
projected-void-fields.text: Improve the Save characteristic (to a maximum of 3+) of friendly units by 1 whilst they are wholly within 8" of any units with this ability that do not have the Supersonic ability.

skyborne-predator.name: Skyborne Predator
skyborne-predator.text: Add 1 to hit rolls for attacks made by this unit that target units that can FLY.

crazed.name: Crazed
crazed.text: At the end of the Action phase, roll one D6 for each blast marker next to this unit; if any of those dice results are a 6, you can make one Shoot action or one Fight action with this unit.
